'''Chris Gober''' (born {{birth based on age as of date|46|2026|3|3|noage=yes}}) is an American politician from [[Texas]]. A [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]], he is the member-elect for {{ushr|TX|10}} in the [[US House of Representatives]].

==Early life and education==
Chris Gober was born in 1979 or 1980.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Chris Gober |url=https://www.clubforgrowth.org/candidates/chris-gober/ |website=[[Club for Growth]]}}</ref> Gober graduated from [[Texas A&M University]]. He worked on the [[George W. Bush 2000 presidential campaign]]. He declined to work in the [[George W. Bush administration]], enrolling at [[Harvard Law School]], where he graduated with a [[Juris Doctor]] in 2004.<ref>{{cite web |last=Curtis |first=Ian |date=March 2, 2026 |title='BTHO the Radical Left': Inside Chris Gober's '01 approach to law, congressional campaign |url=https://thebatt.com/news/btho-the-radical-left-inside-chris-gobers-01-approach-to-law-congressional-campaign/ |access-date=September 2, 2026 |website=The Battalion}}</ref>

==Career==
Gober worked for [[America PAC]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Schleifer |first=Theodore |date=January 31, 2025 |title=Musk Lawyer Tries to Build a Powerhouse Firm With a Billionaire Client |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2025/01/31/us/politics/musk-trump-lawyer.html |work=The New York Times |via=NYTimes.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Autullo |first=Ryan |last2=Killelea |first2=Eric |date=October 3, 2025 |title=Elon Musk PAC's Lawyer Files for Congressional Seat in Texas (1) |url=https://news.bloomberglaw.com/business-and-practice/elon-musk-pacs-lawyer-files-for-congressional-seat-in-texas |website=[[Bloomberg Law]]}}</ref> He founded a law firm, Lex Politica, to focus on House and Senate Republicans.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Thomas |first1=David |last2=Scarcella |first2=Mike |last3=Thomas |first3=David |date=January 31, 2025 |title=Lawyers for Musk, Republican campaigns form new Washington firm |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/us/lawyers-musk-republican-campaigns-form-new-washington-firm-2025-01-31/ |access-date=March 4, 2026 |work=Reuters |language=en-US}}</ref> Gober's financial disclosures show that he has a net worth between $32&nbsp;million and $107&nbsp;million.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Birenbaum |first1=Gabby |last2=Ngo |first2=Hien An |date=July 22, 2026 |title=Millionaires could dominate Texas' next congressional delegation |url=https://www.texastribune.org/2026/07/22/texas-congress-delegation-net-worth-millionaires-2026-midterms/ |access-date=September 2, 2026 |website=The Texas Tribune}}</ref>

In October 2025, Gober announced his campaign for the [[United States House of Representatives]] to represent {{ushr|TX|10}} in the 2026 elections.<ref>https://news.bloomberglaw.com/business-and-practice/elon-musk-pacs-lawyer-files-for-congressional-seat-in-texas</ref> Gober won the primary election without going to a runoff<ref>https://thetexan.news/elections/2026/chris-gober-wins-gop-primary-for-congressman-michael-mccauls-seat/article_3ac813ae-d190-49a7-990a-649223be0b58.html</ref> and won the November general election.<ref>https://www.kbtx.com/2026/11/04/republican-chris-gober-wins-us-house-district-10-race/</ref>
